THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
091
STUDY 007
Cream Knit Co-ord
Rights check
Source: 4992.jpg
Soft, feminine, classic
WORKING NOTES
- Swap the copper hair for a dark or blonde shade for a
different look.
- A cropped, three-quarter framing works well for social
media ads.
Try this: Swap the copper hair for a dark shade.
IMAGE PROMPT
A full-length studio fashion portrait of an
original young woman with long,
voluminous copper-auburn wavy hair,
standing against a seamless white
backdrop. She wears a matching cream
knit co-ord: a cropped, long-sleeved
cardigan with a textured, slightly sparkly
tweed weave and pearl buttons down
the front, layered over a knit camisole,
paired with a fitted knit mini skirt with two
front flap pockets and a ribbed
waistband. A thin chain necklace sits at
her neck. She wears cream knee-high
boots and holds a black quilted shoulder
bag with silver hardware at her side. Her
expression is calm and direct, gazing
toward the camera. Soft, even studio
lighting with minimal shadow, a clean,
neutral palette of ivory, cream, and pale
gold, with warm copper hair as the
single accent. Polished, romantic, and
classic, in the style of a contemporary
knitwear lookbook.
